candidate_relations.reason: Mantle cell lymphoma is a mature B-cell lymphoma, not a salivary gland tumor.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad salivary epithelial tumor category rather than lymphoid malignancy

candidate_relations.reason: Palatal fibromatosis is a distinct non-lymphoid proliferative disorder and does not represent mantle cell lymphoma.
A palatal torus is an osseous lesion, whereas the reference is mantle cell lymphoma; the operative finding of uninvolved bone also argues against it.
Lipoma is a distinct mesenchymal tumor and is not a subtype or component of mantle cell lymphoma.
Cherubism is a familial childhood jaw-bone disease, not a B-cell lymphoma, and the presentation lacks jaw-bone involvement.
Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is an inflammatory vasculitic disease rather than mantle cell lymphoma.
Myxoma is a separate benign or locally aggressive mesenchymal tumor and not mantle cell lymphoma.
Neurofibroma is a distinct neural tumor and has no subtype or component equivalence to mantle cell lymphoma.
Osteoma is an osseous tumor rather than a lymphoid malignancy, and the palatal bone was described as uninvolved.

case_quality_flags: The clinical record lacks histopathology, immunophenotyping, or molecular findings needed to independently establish mantle cell lymphoma.
No candidate names mantle cell lymphoma or a broader lymphoma category.
